verdict.rationale: A desktop app is a fair axis for an authenticator and password vault, but the evidence pack describes only a mobile app. Downloads point to the Apple app store, approvals happen "on your phone," and the PC appears only as the place where the sign-in page is shown. Community comments call it "a mobile app," and one IT team is trialing the third-party WinAuth on Windows desktops instead, which suggests no first-party desktop surface.

support.subject: As a power user, a first-class desktop app gives me codes and vault access on my computer, not just on mobile
